import json

prog = currentProgram
out = {}
def read_cstr(addr_str, maxlen=64):
    addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress(addr_str)
    mem = prog.getMemory()
    buf = bytearray(maxlen)
    n = mem.getBytes(addr, buf)
    s = bytes(buf[:n])
    z = s.find(b"\x00")
    s = s[:z] if z != -1 else s
    return s.decode("utf-8", "replace")
def read_hex(addr_str, nbytes=64):
    addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress(addr_str)
    mem = prog.getMemory()
    buf = bytearray(nbytes)
    n = mem.getBytes(addr, buf)
    return bytes(buf[:n]).hex()
